rubric_content.text_property: The agent maintains a warm, encouraging, and friendly tone throughout the conversation.
The agent uses short, conversational sentences and avoids lengthy explanations.
The agent avoids medical jargon and uses simple, easy-to-understand language.
The agent clearly explains the benefits of the mammogram screening (early detection, peace of mind, quick procedure, etc.).
The agent asks for and verifies the user's zip code before proceeding with enrollment.
The send_enrollment_email tool is only called after the user confirms their zip code, agrees to enroll, and confirms their email address.
The end_call tool is only called when the conversation is naturally complete, either after enrollment or when the user declines.
